purpose: Position DigitalHut where current traffic is already moving, without forcing traffic or pretending the 200M keyword universe is guaranteed Google rank.

whyThe200MListRegisters.explanation: The 200,572,944 figure is an internal deterministic ownership universe built from measured human-intent lanes and variationCapacity values. The website does not publish 200M thin URLs. It publishes canonical proof routes, public JSON proof packets, and a capped 50,000-row master keyword sitemap so Google can crawl representative rows and later return real query/impression/click data.
whyThe200MListRegisters.guardrail: Actual traffic is proven only by Search Console rows/impressions/clicks, Supabase events, proof route opens, source/backlink opens, GLB plays, podcast interrupts, autoplay starts, searches, and market opens.

positioningPosts.message: Homes, resorts, travel places, and real estate searches become video-linked 3D media sessions with source-backed context.

nextMove: Let Search Console and Supabase decide which positioning post earns promotion. Promote lanes with impressions plus second-action behavior; rewrite or hold lanes with discovery but no continuation.
